fields.name: UserId
fields.evidence: Toolkit EoCClient.dll+0x7C6300 LightbarHapticsSystem::CalculateEntityColor puts eoc::user::ReservedForComponent's user id (or Unassigned) at LightbarColorData+0, after checking its high 16 bits against net::GetLocalPeerID(); FinalizeComponents (EoCClient.dll+0x7C6B90) copies data+0 to component+0. Live: 1 in all 3 instances.

fields.name: Color
fields.evidence: ls::Color<float> filled by CalculateSpell/CalculateStatus (EoCClient.dll+0x7C6560 copies 16 bytes of a lightbar settings entry); FinalizeComponents copies data+4..+0x13 to component+4..+0x13. Live: all zero (no spell/status color in idle).

fields.name: Brightness
fields.evidence: CalculateEntityColor stores CalculateBrightness(this, anyQueryHit) at data+0x14; FinalizeComponents copies it to component+0x14 (component stride 0x1C). Live: 1.0.

fields.name: HasColor
fields.evidence: bool set to true by CalculateSpell/CalculateStatus when they supplied a color (param_4 = true), stored at data+0x18 and copied as one byte to component+0x18; FinalizeComponents uses 1.0 when it is 0. Live: 0.

fields.name: _Pad19
fields.evidence: Padding up to the 28-byte size; live bytes there vary (05/33/59) = uninitialised.

open_questions: HasColor name: the flag means a spell or status color overrides the default; its consumer was not read in full.
